title: Introduction Body Hover Emphasizes Content
description: When the mouse is inside the body of the introduction step window, all content should be emphasized (text and icons), matching existing shell hover emphasis patterns. Keep celebrate paint intact.
summary: Introduction step windows now emphasize all content (title chip, body copy/checklist/icons, step chip, close) while the pointer is inside the body via CSS :has(body:hover) + body :hover rules on the emphasized color token. Celebrate paint is excluded. Extended vitest for the CSS contract and markup slots.
